happens: A root lifts a paving stone out of place.
point: slow growth moves a heavy fixed thing

happens: A stick grows into a tree that gives shade.
point: something small grows large over years

happens: The pear stays hard although it is pressed daily.
point: checking does not speed up ripening

happens: The bridge stands because two banks hold it.
point: one thing depends on support from two sides

happens: You sign a complaint others only agreed with aloud.
point: one person puts their name to it

happens: Your thumb stops before sending the angry reply.
point: pausing just before an act of anger

happens: The language comes out without effort.
point: daily repetition makes a skill automatic

happens: Someone cooks from a card another person wrote.
point: using instructions handed on by someone else

happens: A song comes on and both start singing.
point: a chore turns into shared pleasure

happens: A shoot splits the tarmac.
point: a soft growing thing breaks hard ground

happens: The cat hisses and your hand stops.
point: a warning stops an approach

happens: The pole bends in the wind and the tent survives.
point: bending instead of breaking keeps it standing

happens: The key stays on the ring though it fits nothing.
point: keeping a thing that no longer works

happens: People laugh louder under one umbrella as rain continues.
point: bad conditions bring people closer and merrier

happens: The adult does not fix the child's wrong knot.
point: holding back help so someone learns

happens: The red light stops you while a lorry passes.
point: a rule that holds you back protects you

happens: The old beams hold up a new roof.
point: the old core carries what is rebuilt

happens: Swallows rebuild on the remains of their old nest.
point: building again on what was left

happens: People are pleased with a puzzle missing one piece.
point: being content with something incomplete

happens: The seedling droops, then grows a new leaf.
point: a move sets back before it helps

happens: Someone says the unspoken thing and the room relaxes.
point: saying it aloud releases shared tension

happens: The old tooth is out and the new one has not come.
point: the gap between losing and getting

happens: You turn the map and find the road.
point: changing the view reveals what was there

happens: The flight is cancelled and the plan collapses.
point: one outside event wipes out a plan

happens: The riders struggle, then pedal in time and go fast.
point: matching rhythm turns struggle into speed

happens: You understand old advice when you tell it to another.
point: passing something on makes you understand it

happens: You turn the unnamed parcel over before opening it.
point: hesitating before something of unknown origin

happens: A vase picture becomes two faces and stays so.
point: a new way of seeing cannot be undone
plausible: no - such pictures keep flipping back

happens: Hail falls and knocks all the leaves down.
point: a short violent event strips everything
plausible: no - hail rarely strips every leaf

happens: The dog stops pulling once the lead is slack.
point: resistance ends when the pull ends

happens: You notice the radio only when it names your street.
point: attention wakes when it concerns you

happens: The film stays in the camera, its contents forgotten.
point: something recorded but never looked at

happens: The light ahead grows larger than the light behind.
point: passing the midpoint, the end gets nearer

happens: The storm blows away the trampoline but not the shed.
point: the light new thing goes, the old stays

happens: The saw cuts only when both pull and neither pushes.
point: forcing it jams the shared work

happens: People wear a path nobody planned.
point: real use makes the route, not plans

happens: The baker keeps the oven shut so the cake holds.
point: looking too early would ruin it

happens: The cursor blinks on a page with nothing typed.
point: a start that has not been made

happens: You send one message before the battery dies.
point: scarcity forces choosing what matters

happens: You hear a friend use your phrase.
point: seeing yourself through someone else's copy

happens: You miss your turning on an easy road.
point: ease makes you stop paying attention

happens: The door opens a little so you can see out.
point: opening partly while staying protected

happens: You leave an unlabelled box empty.
point: not answering what was not asked clearly

happens: You build the fire fully before striking the match.
point: one chance, so prepare first

happens: You look for your own face first.
point: people check themselves before others

happens: The swimmer struggles, then swims in rhythm.
point: effort settles into rhythm after a hard start

happens: The whistle turns swimmers back from the current.
point: a warning stops people before danger

happens: The signpost has lost its direction boards.
point: a guide that no longer gives direction

happens: Your hand keeps reaching for a tap with no water.
point: absence shows how often you relied on it

happens: Someone copies your walk and everyone recognises you.
point: others know you by a habit

happens: The torch shows the keys and other lost things.
point: searching for one thing uncovers more

happens: The bird fakes an injury and leads the fox away.
point: pretending weakness to draw danger off

happens: The barrel overflows onto the potato bed.
point: what is over-full spills on to feed others

happens: The waterfall has frozen solid.
point: moving water stopped by cold

happens: Your foot brakes before you see the reason.
point: the body reacts before the mind knows

happens: You change the bulb and see the shabby walls.
point: fixing one thing shows other neglect

happens: The fog clears and the valley becomes visible.
point: what was around you suddenly shows

happens: The unused battery is flat when needed.
point: what is never used fails when needed

happens: Bubbles rise and stop under the ice.
point: something rising is stopped by a lid

happens: The float dips once before anything shows.
point: a first small sign of something unseen

happens: An idea comes and half is lost before writing.
point: a thought fades unless caught quickly

happens: The sun reaches the path and melts the frost.
point: warmth arrives and the frost goes

happens: The used bicycle runs; the stored one has seized.
point: use keeps things working, storage stiffens them

happens: A drop freezes on the icicle before falling.
point: something caught at the last moment

happens: A damp patch shows where hidden water ran.
point: a visible mark reveals a hidden process

happens: The dish is returned with baking in it.
point: a loan is returned with a gift

happens: You stand still until your eyes adjust to daylight.
point: needing time to adjust after a change

happens: The stuck car rolls when you push it.
point: it moves only with your own effort

happens: People leave their cars and look at the view.
point: a forced stop lets people notice surroundings

happens: The chrysalis hangs still while the caterpillar dissolves inside.
point: total change hidden behind outward stillness

happens: One pours coffee, the other cuts cake, uncounted.
point: giving to each other without keeping score

happens: You report the ball out and your team loses the point.
point: honesty that costs your own side

happens: The window opens suddenly under your full weight.
point: full force frees what was stuck

happens: You dig up the seed and stop its growth.
point: checking on growth destroys it

happens: The suitcase is packed and ready by the door.
point: preparation is finished, only leaving remains

happens: You help someone up and their grip steadies you.
point: helping another supports the helper too

happens: You accept one of two invitations for one evening.
point: choosing one means giving up the other
